import{useEffect}from'react';/**
 * Custom hook for keyboard navigation
 * Handles arrow key events for carousel navigation
 * 
 * @param {Function} onLeft - Callback for left arrow key
 * @param {Function} onRight - Callback for right arrow key
 */export function useKeyboardNavigation(onLeft,onRight){useEffect(()=>{const handleKeyDown=event=>{if(event.key==='ArrowLeft'&&onLeft){onLeft();}else if(event.key==='ArrowRight'&&onRight){onRight();}};window.addEventListener('keydown',handleKeyDown);return()=>window.removeEventListener('keydown',handleKeyDown);},[onLeft,onRight]);}
